name: Social media, e-commerce & app icon resizer
description: One-click image resizer pre-loaded with official platform dimensions from `presets/social-media-sizes.json`, `ecommerce-sizes.json`, and `developer-icons.json` (Amazon 1000×1000, Shopify 2048×2048, LinkedIn 400×400 & 1584×396 Banner, Instagram 1080×1080, YouTube 1280×720, OG Image 1200×630, iOS/Android App Icon 512×512).

faqs.question: Does Social media, e-commerce & app icon resizer upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Social media, e-commerce & app icon resizer executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/image/image-resize-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Social media, e-commerce & app icon resizer?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/social_resizer.json or open /tools/social-resizer?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
